name: Amamiya Henri
source:
"I'm looking for a girl who can take me seriously! Nah, you know what I mean?"

A junior member of Kanade and Kyoichiro, he is a light-footed and playful bassist. He is not shy and is well-liked by many. He is always a mood-maker, and is outwardly affable, but on the inside he has a more optimistic and pessimistic side.

He has a habit of taking pictures of anything and everything, uploading them to social networking sites, and sharing them.

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/live/original/character/amamiya_henri.html]official website[/url]]
